weapons.name: Macuahuitl
weapons.design: A dark reddish hardwood MACUAHUITL war club, long flat wooden paddle with sharp black-purple obsidian blades on BOTH edges, turquoise cord grip. Right hand gripping handle, left hand only assisting during heavy strike. Not a metal sword.
weapons.rows: ROW1 four-frame PRIMARY SLASH: ready club diagonal on right, windup pulled right, slash sweeps left across view with subtle purple obsidian streak, follow-through left. ROW2 HEAVY: raise club up-right, overhead preparation, forceful downward diagonal swing, lowered followthrough. ROW3 RESET/GUARD: weapon low, left hand steadies grip, raise to defensive diagonal, original ready.
weapons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FIRST-PERSON VIEWMODEL animation sprite sheet for UMBRAL retro boomer shooter. Create ONE transparent landscape 4:3 sheet EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS x THREE ROWS of equal square cells, 12 frames total. Each cell is a complete 1990s DOOM-like weapon HUD overlay seen THROUGH THE WIELDER'S EYES: only his two medium-brown human hands, short charcoal frayed cuffs, and weapon; NO full character, NO face, NO third-person camera, NO side-on inventory icon. Strong foreshortening. Firearms point AWAY from viewer toward distant upper-center; never show their front barrel pointing AT viewer. Crisp chunky hand-dithered pixel art, limited palette, gritty high contrast, no painterly smoothing. Same weapon geometry and hand anatomy through all frames. At most TWO hands, five fingers each; fingers wrapped around grips. Entire hands and weapon within cell with 8 percent TRANSPARENT padding at every edge, no cell bleed. Each square is an overlay viewport: anchor forearm ends near y88%, weapon idle occupies lower 60%, upper area reserved for muzzle flash/swing. Keep FIXED camera, consistent scale, origins across all cells; don't re-center poses. Transparent alpha, NO text, labels, grid, floor, scenery, enemies, watermark, extra loose weapons. Each row has four successive distinct keyframes, read left to right. Intentional transparent margins around wrist ends for packing. weapons.name: Escopeta de obsidiana
weapons.design: Compact break-action DOUBLE BARREL SHOTGUN of worn gunmetal, dark carved wood, small turquoise inlays and black obsidian edge ornament. Two parallel barrels aimed AWAY from viewer at upper center; see receiver and TOPS of barrels, not front of muzzle.
weapons.rows: ROW1 SINGLE SHOT: ready, brief small orange-purple muzzle flash at distant barrel tip, kickback upward, settle. ROW2 DOUBLE SHOT: ready tense grip, large bifurcated orange-purple flash at far muzzle, powerful upward recoil, lowered recovery. ROW3 RELOAD: tilt break-action open, empty two chambers visible viewed from breech, left hand inserts two dark cartridges, close action and return toward ready.

weapons.name: Cañón solar
weapons.design: Heavy retro sci-fantasy SOLAR PLASMA CANNON, bronze engraved casing, dark basalt ribs, glowing amber circular heat chambers, small turquoise accents, thick central forward barrel. Right hand trigger bottom-right left hand support bottom-left, barrel points away upper center.
weapons.rows: ROW1 PULSE: ready low amber core, bright yellow-white shot from distant muzzle, recoil with orange hot vents, settle. ROW2 CHARGED: dim ready, orange core charges brighter, concentrated large golden sun orb released at far muzzle, smoking cooling stance. ROW3 VENT: hot vents glow, upper bronze fins lift, brief gold embers escape, fins close core dim.

weapons.name: Clavadora de Itztepec
weapons.design: Slim brutal industrial NAILGUN rifle, angular black steel and purple obsidian crystal magazine, bone-colored rail accents, tiny ochre engravings. Projectile weapon, no crossbow limbs. Two hands, barrel points away up-center, visible top rail.
weapons.rows: ROW1 BURST: ready, short violet sparks at far muzzle while launching narrow obsidian nails, bolt snaps backward recoil, settles. ROW2 STAKE: ready, angular purple charge gathers on top rail, one thick black-purple obsidian lance leaves distant muzzle with bright violet flash, recoil. ROW3 RELOAD: tilt receiver to left, left hand removes dark crystal cassette, left hand inserts new violet cassette, ready with bolt reset.

weapons.name: Incensario de guerra
weapons.design: Short thick hand-held fantasy GRENADE LAUNCHER, round copper incense-burner chamber in ribbed bone cage, turquoise glowing apertures, soot-black forward tube and wooden pistol grip. Explicit gun-shaped forward launcher NOT swinging censer. Two hands. Barrel points away upper center.
weapons.rows: ROW1 GRENADE: ready, compact orange ember grenade launches from far muzzle with amber flash, chamber kicks up briefly, settle. ROW2 CLOUD: ready, turquoise chamber opens vents, a short teal luminous smoke burst jets forward from far muzzle, dim recovery with wisps. ROW3 RELOAD: rotate bronze chamber open, left hand loads small amber glowing coal capsule, close cage and latch, original ready.

weapons.name: Coaiztlactli
weapons.design: Ceremonial OBSIDIAN KNIFE, black glossy flaked stone blade with sharp jagged edge, purple rim highlights, turquoise SERPENT shaped handle, little red woven grip. Right hand holds knife forward, left empty hand open for balance. No snake creature, no victim.
weapons.rows: ROW1 SLASH: ready right side blade forward, wrist pulls slightly back, fast diagonal slash left with faint violet trail, followthrough. ROW2 THRUST: ready, knife hand pulls back close to camera, straight foreshortened forward thrust toward vanishing point, retract. ROW3 GUARD: knife lowered, wrist rotates blade upright, left hand opens in defensive pose, initial forward ready. No glory kill, no enemy, no extraction or execution.
